name: quran-turn
description: Read the Qur'an while Codex takes its turn. Offline, no account, no tracking.

interface.shortDescription: Read the Qur'an while Codex works
interface.longDescription: Opens a quiet Qur'an reader when you send a prompt: on macOS it comes out of the notch, shows how long Codex has been working, turns yellow when Codex needs your approval and green when the turn is done, then folds away with your exact ayah saved. The Tanzil Uthmani text ships verbatim and is checksum-verified before it renders. Fully offline; no account, sync or analytics.
